open.notJson: This file is not a View-3D project: it is not valid JSON (line {{line}}).
open.notAProject: This file is not a valid View-3D project.

close.title: Close without saving?
close.body: Your changes since the last save will be lost.

room.title: Room
room.editRefused: That change would turn the room inside out, so it was not made.
room.zeroWall: Wall {{n}} has no length, so it has no direction to lengthen. Use "Edit the walls" instead.

walls.title: Type the walls
walls.hint: Go round the room turning left. For each wall, type its length and the inside angle where it ends: 90 for an ordinary corner, 270 for a corner that points into the room.
walls.incomplete: Fill in every length and angle to check the room.
walls.open: The walls do not close: the last wall ends {{gap}} from the start.
walls.suspects: One of these values is probably mistyped:
walls.useAngle: Use {{value}} for the end angle of wall {{n}}
walls.diagonalOff: The diagonal differs from the drawing by {{difference}}.
walls.closesWithin: The walls close: the last wall ended {{gap}} from the start, so it is drawn from the corners, not from its typed length.

draw.title: Draw the room
draw.hint: Click each corner in turn. Corners snap to a grid (10 cm on a large screen); type the exact lengths afterwards.
draw.notARoom: These corners do not make a room: the walls cross or a corner repeats.

openings.title: Doors, windows and columns
openings.wallNumber: Type the number of the wall (1, 2, 3 ...).
openings.doorItem: Door {{n}}: wall {{wall}}, {{offset}} from its start, {{width}} wide
openings.entranceItem: Entrance {{n}}: wall {{wall}}, {{offset}} from its start, {{width}} wide
openings.windowItem: Window {{n}}: wall {{wall}}, {{offset}} from its start, {{width}} wide

column.title: New column
column.hint: Measured from corner 1: x to the right, y upwards on the plan, to the column's lower-left corner.

problems.too-few-vertices: The room needs at least 3 corners.
problems.non-integer-coordinate: A corner position is not a whole number of micrometres.
problems.coordinate-out-of-range: A corner is more than 100 m from the origin.
problems.zero-length-edge: Two corners in a row are the same point. Remove the repeated corner.
problems.self-intersection: The outline crosses or touches itself. Check the order of the corners.
problems.clockwise: The outline runs clockwise. List the corners counter-clockwise (reverse their order).
problems.opening-wall-missing: {{kind}} "{{id}}" is on wall {{wall}}, but the room has only {{wallCount}} walls.
problems.opening-off-wall: {{kind}} "{{id}}" is {{width}} wide and starts {{offset}} along wall {{wall}}, which is {{length}} long: it runs {{over}} past the end of the wall.
problems.opening-off-wall-position: {{kind}} "{{id}}" does not lie on wall {{wall}}: check its position and width.
problems.opening-above-ceiling: {{kind}} "{{id}}" reaches {{top}} above the floor, higher than the {{ceiling}} ceiling.
problems.column-outside-room: Column "{{id}}" is not completely inside the room.
problems.no-entrance: The room has no entrance. Mark one door as the entrance; aisles are checked from there.

input.not-a-number: This is not a length. Type a number such as 1200, 120 cm or 5' 3 1/2".
input.unknown-unit: Unknown unit. Use mm, cm, m, in (") or ft (').
input.not-positive: A length must be more than zero.
input.too-large: A length can be at most 100 m.
input.use-a-point: Use a point for decimals (1.5), not a comma.
input.out-of-range: An angle must be more than 0 and less than 360 degrees.

angleInput.not-a-number: This is not an angle. Type a number of degrees such as 90 or 135.5.
angleInput.out-of-range: An angle must be more than 0 and less than 360 degrees.
angleInput.use-a-point: Use a point for decimals (90.5), not a comma.

capture.too-few-walls: A room needs at least 3 walls.
capture.wall-length-not-positive: Wall {{n}}: the length must be more than zero.
capture.not-an-integer: Wall {{n}}: the length or the corner angle is not a whole number of micrometres or micro-degrees.
capture.corner-angle-out-of-range: Corner at the end of wall {{n}}: the angle must be more than 0 and less than 360 degrees.

warnings.wall-very-short: Wall {{n}} is shorter than {{limit}}. Is the length right?
warnings.wall-very-long: Wall {{n}} is longer than {{limit}}. Is the length right?
warnings.corner-very-sharp: The corner at the end of wall {{n}} is very sharp. Is the angle right?

scan.title: Check the scan
scan.findingsLabel: What the scan did not know
scan.windowSize: A window {{width}} wide and {{height}} high on wall {{wall}}.

findings.gap-closed: A {{size}} gap at the end of wall {{wall}} was closed.
findings.gap-filled: The scan has a {{size}} gap at wall {{wall}}; it is drawn as a straight wall. It may be a doorway: add the door in the editor.
findings.window-sill-unknown: The scan does not know the sill height of the window on wall {{wall}}. Type it, or leave the window out.
findings.window-not-on-wall: A window in the scan is {{distance}} from the nearest wall, so it was left out.
findings.no-doors: The scan has no doors. Add the entrance and every door in the editor.
findings.doors-not-read: The scan lists {{doors}} doors, which this version cannot read. Add them in the editor.
findings.ceiling-height-varies: The scanned wall heights vary from {{min}} to {{max}}. Check the ceiling height.
findings.axes-assumed: The scan is read as seen from above. If the plan looks mirrored compared with the shop, tell us.
findings.window-moved: The window on wall {{wall}} ran past the end of the wall in the scan; it was moved {{moved}} to fit. Check it.

errors.not-json: This file is not a room scan: it is not valid JSON.
errors.not-roomtrace: This file is not a RoomTrace scan.
errors.unsupported-version: This RoomTrace file uses a format version that cannot be read (only version 2).
errors.unsupported-units: Only RoomTrace files measured in metres can be read.
errors.no-rooms: The scan has no room in it.
errors.several-rooms: The scan has several rooms; import one room at a time.
errors.bad-wall: A wall or window in the scan has no position or size.
errors.too-few-walls: The scan has fewer than 3 walls.
errors.outline-invalid: The scanned walls do not make a room: they cross each other or repeat a corner.
errors.no-height: The scan has no ceiling or wall height.

files.readFailed: The file "{{file}}" could not be read.
files.writeFailed: The file "{{file}}" could not be saved.

diagnostics.title: Diagnostics
diagnostics.intro: Measures how smoothly this computer draws the 3D view: the same shop with real products, drawn four ways. It takes about a minute. Please do not use the computer while it runs.
diagnostics.noWebgl: 3D is not available on this computer (no WebGL 2). The 2D plan still works.
diagnostics.pass: Smooth enough: 30 frames per second or better with 60 fixtures.
diagnostics.fail: Not smooth enough for 60 fixtures yet.
diagnostics.photo: Please send a photo of this page.
